description: The cooling actions a SHADE policy is allowed to place, with the physical edit each one makes to the SOLWEIG raster stack and an order-of-magnitude unit cost. The physical parameters are the ones Boston's own heat study used, so a policy evaluated here is being scored against the same assumptions the city planned with. The costs are NOT city figures -- see cost_caveat.
physics_source: Klimaat Consulting & Innovation, 'Neighbourhood Urban Climate Simulation', Appendix 2 to Heat Resilience Solutions for Boston (2021-09-24), Appendix A layer specifications. Local copy: data/heat/Appendix2_NeighborhoodClimateSimulationModeling.pdf
cost_caveat: Unit costs are from Klimaat Consulting, Appendix 3 to Heat Resilience Solutions for Boston (2022), the city's own cost schedule for heat interventions. Shade canopy costs use the fabric awning figure ($98/SF); tree costs use the no-drainage-box figure ($2,024/tree). The $500,000 per-neighborhood budget aligns with a bottom-up corridor estimate (~$585K-$654K) and with the $11.4M USFS urban forestry grant divided across 20 Main Streets districts ($570K/district).

light_road.label: High-SRI reflective road coating
light_road.reported_effect: Boston study: afternoon surface temperature 104F -> 93F; perceived temperature 90F -> 88.6F. Shade still dominates over albedo for pedestrian comfort.
light_road.cost_source: Klimaat Appendix 3: $190.12/linear foot for 28 ft width (StreetBond coating, 3 applications + friction coat). Converted to m2.

cool_roof.label: Light-coloured / cool roof
cool_roof.cost_source: Klimaat Appendix 3: $6.50/SF for temporary light-colored painted roof coating. Converted to m2.

green_roof.label: Green roof
green_roof.cost_source: Klimaat Appendix 3: $35.00/SF for green roof. Converted to m2.

tree_small.label: Small street tree
tree_small.cost_source: Klimaat Appendix 3: $2,023.70/tree (3-inch caliper, no drainage box; includes excavation, disposal, bioretention soil mix / crushed stone).

tree_medium.label: Medium street tree
tree_medium.cost_source: Klimaat Appendix 3: $6,687.33/tree (3-inch caliper with drainage box; includes excavation, installation). Medium trees in Boston sidewalks typically require drainage infrastructure.
tree_medium.reported_effect: Boston study, trees on the north side of the street: afternoon surface temperature 105F -> 90F, perceived temperature 90F -> 85F. The largest single-measure effect in their tests.

shade_canopy.label: Shade cloth canopy / awning
shade_canopy.cost_source: Klimaat Appendix 3: $98/SF for fabric awnings (light gauge steel frame, 50x20 ft canopy; includes installation, spread footings, LED lighting). Converted to m2.

solar_canopy.label: PV solar canopy
solar_canopy.cost_source: Klimaat Appendix 3: $155.40/SF for prefab metal canopy (~$1,673/m2), plus ~$475/m2 for integrated PV panels. No direct Klimaat PV canopy figure; this is an estimate.
